judgement.reason: Rasa is a framework, and the outcome already requires repository changes such as base image build arguments and a trained model, so it is not too lenient.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported architecture: docker/docker-compose.yml defines 3 application services (rasa, action_server, duckling). Deployz runs ONE web process per deployment plus declared background workers.
reviews.reason: The compose file runs separate action_server and duckling images next to Rasa, and no shown line proves the production app works without them, so the vendor should confirm whether they are needed.
